subject: Helm.ai reports 70 million USD in signed automotive and industrial AI contracts
summary: Helm.ai reported $70 million signed commercial contracts over 12 months spanning automotive, Tier 1 suppliers and industrial automation. It describes one foundation-model lineage for vehicles and robotics development. This is a company-reported amount across sectors, not independently audited robotics revenue, ARR, margins or proof of cross-vendor reuse.
